name: Bidhan Chandra

evidence: LinkedIn CONFIRMED: search for "Bidhan Chandra" + "Chandra & Shaw Associates" returns exactly https://www.linkedin.com/in/dr-bidhan-chandra-7708895/ titled 'Dr. Bidhan Chandra - Gen AI in Education Consultant and Trainer - Chandra & Shaw Associates' and elsewhere 'Dr. Bidhan Chandra - Intercultural Coach'. Independent anchors all match the row: (1) organization Chandra & Shaw Associates in the profile headline; (2) Professor of International Business and Management, School of Business, SUNY Empire State College / Empire State University, Saratoga Springs NY (Albany Capital Region) - directory entry and 2016 news release 'Professor Bidhan Chandra Receives Altes Prize for Exemplary Community Service' for promoting global cultural diversity awareness; (3) topic match - intercultural communication/competence in a global economic environment, cross-cultural training for executives (UB EMBA programs in Beijing and Singapore), 2013 Diversity and Inclusion faculty award; (4) Coursera instructor page https://www.coursera.org/instructor/bchandra matching the 'Mastering American eLearning' anchor.
